eu.nosini.Artemis.appid-url-not-reachable: nosini.eu has no website yet; the linter requires https://nosini.eu to answer.
eu.nosini.Artemis.appstream-external-screenshot-url: Self-hosted repository: screenshots stay at their upstream URLs instead of Flathub's media mirror.
eu.nosini.Artemis.appstream-screenshots-not-mirrored-in-os: Self-hosted repository: no screenshots ref is published.
eu.nosini.Artemis.finish-args-own-name-org.kde.StatusNotif: Avalonia's tray icon owns org.kde.StatusNotifierItem-<pid>-<n> instead of using its unique bus name; without the name, Artemis has no tray icon.
eu.nosini.Artemis.module-artemis-checker-tracks-commits: Artemis has no Git tags; the checker follows the published releases on Artemis's update server, which name the release commit.
